title: Skin Care for a Hill Station Trip: What to Pack and Do
ex: A simple plan for Manali, Shimla, Ooty or Darjeeling: what to pack, a daily routine for cold, wind and strong mountain sun, and how to help skin recover at home.
rt: Skin Care for a Hill Station Trip: Pack & Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for a hill station trip: what to pack, a daily routine for cold air, wind and strong mountain sun, and the night cream to carry for dry skin.
keyword: skin care for hill station trip
quick: In the hills, use a richer night cream, a light moisturiser and SPF 30+ sunscreen every day even when it is cold, and lip balm and hand cream against wind. Keep showers lukewarm, pack products you already use, and moisturise on slightly damp skin.
facts: Sunscreen is needed even on cold, sunny mountain days
Moisturise on slightly damp skin in dry air
Pack products you already know suit you
